title: Cell Construction
description: Internal construction: assembly type, layering, sheet counts, and electrode-assembly geometry.

assembly_type.description: How the electrode/separator stack is assembled.

layering.description: Whether the stack is single- or multilayer.

layer_count.description: Number of layers in the stack.

assembly_sequence.description: Ordered list of stack layers, outside in.

cathode_sheet_count.description: Number of positive-electrode sheets in the stack.

anode_sheet_count.description: Number of negative-electrode sheets in the stack.

electrode_length.description: Unrolled length of one electrode sheet in a wound assembly.

jellyroll_volume.description: Volume of the wound or stacked electrode assembly (jelly roll or stack).
